correction: The closed case02 copy is NOT byte-identical to its input. Earlier unchanged-original wording means mutation=none/source input unchanged only; it does not prove semantic equality of the opened/closed DB.
existing_execution_sequence: Python driver reads original public C10 bytes and writes inputs/0.sqlite; original-inputs.before.json hashes both, and execution-summary input_drift=[] confirms both still match afterwards.

Test reads inputs/0.sqlite, verifies Digest(input) against the registered hash, then os.WriteFile writes these bytes to its new case.sqlite. There is no separately captured disk hash between WriteFile and store.Open.

store.Open opens that case copy read/write, asks for foreign_keys=1,journal_mode=WAL,synchronous=FULL,busy_timeout=5000; Ready reads the effective PRAGMAs and quick_check. Reaching validator proves Open/Ready succeeded, not the initial journal state.

Test reads trigger inventory after Open. mutation=none skips the entire trigger-drop, UPDATE/DELETE and rehash block. No SQLite backup API, CreateBackup, RestoreBackup, VACUUM or archive edit was invoked in this case.

First validator runs in a transaction then explicit Rollback. Second validateModelStreamBackup begins its own transaction and returns at the same provider error, with deferred Rollback. No intentional business-row write is in this executed path.

Cleanup executes PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE), closes db, then reads/hashes closed case.sqlite. It also rechecks the unchanged inputs/0.sqlite. The raw contains the validator failure and no additional cleanup error output.

cause_assessment.proven: The code opens a writable SQLite copy with WAL-related setup, performs a checkpoint and closes before the changed byte hash is taken. Both exact byte hashes are recorded.
cause_assessment.not_proven: The precise changed pages/header fields and whether WAL/header conversion alone accounts for every byte are NOT recorded. No initial header/page vector, journal-mode-before-open value or paired whole-DB semantic vector exists in this attempt. Therefore WAL/header conversion is a plausible explanation, not an established complete cause.
cause_assessment.no_reconstruction: This supplement performs no new SQL, byte-page probe or validator run and does not manufacture historical vectors.
